selection_note: Requirement-backed composite, read-only flow for live execution. It includes authentication because the CLI does not yet persist an authenticated-session fixture across separately generated test cases.

test_cases.title: Public-demo user opens Directory Job Title listbox
preconditions: The public OrangeHRM demo login page is open.
The page visibly publishes demo Username Admin and Password admin123.

steps.action: Enter Admin in Username and admin123 in Password, then select Login.
Select the Directory link in the authenticated sidepanel.
Activate the custom Job Title control currently displaying -- Select -- by clicking it; do not use native select_option because this page exposes a custom listbox.
Observe the options in the opened listbox.
steps.expected: The visible listbox contains -- Select --, HR Manager, QA Engineer, and Software Engineer.

test_cases.expected_result: The Directory Job Title custom listbox is visible and contains the observed options -- Select --, HR Manager, QA Engineer, and Software Engineer.
test_cases.source_excerpt: ORH-04 and ORH-05 observed Directory screen and Job Title listbox.
